one_line: OpenAI seeks massive funding while AI policies tighten, safety concerns rise, and compute capacity expands globally.

themes.title: OpenAI seeks $30 billion funding
themes.text: OpenAI is negotiating a private funding round of up to $30 billion that would value the company at $1.25 trillion pre‑money, led by Coatue and investors from the United Arab Emirates.

stories.headline: OpenAI seeks up to $30 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of IPO

themes.title: Governments and firms limit AI tools
themes.text: Swedish government ministries have prohibited staff from using ChatGPT and Claude on work computers, requiring Microsoft Copilot as the only approved AI tool. Meta’s updated commercial terms allow business accounts to authorize scraping of associated websites, including news sites, for AI training, and several major U.S. banks are restricting third‑party AI agents from accessing customer accounts after detecting unauthorized activity.

stories.headline: Swedish government offices ban ChatGPT and Claude, require Microsoft Copilot
Meta’s new commercial terms could let it scrape news sites for AI training
Major US banks block third‑party AI agents from customer accounts

themes.title: Safety incidents and research findings
themes.text: OpenAI terminated three safety researchers after an internal investigation said they leaked internal model designs, and Chinese‑aligned hackers used the open‑source AI framework ARTEX to breach ConnectWise and access about 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants. Separate research reported that reinforcement learning from human feedback did not consistently improve instrumental behavior in OLMo‑3, that the EpiSEM‑Bench benchmark evaluates LLM agents on tasks with missing safety facts, and that Claude generated formal proofs for security properties across 123 open‑source libraries, producing roughly 180 million lines of Rocq proofs.

stories.headline: OpenAI fires three safety researchers over alleged leak of internal model designs
Chinese hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants
Study finds RLVR training does not consistently increase instrumental behavior in OLMo-3
EpiSEM-Bench evaluates safety of LLM agents when key facts are omitted
Anthropic uses Claude to formally verify security properties in 123 open-source libraries

themes.title: Global AI compute capacity expands
themes.text: NVIDIA unveiled the Minerva AIOps platform for AI factory observability, and Schneider Electric announced a collaboration with NVIDIA and HPE to deliver Industrial AI Agents at the Edge. SpaceX plans to manage at least 13 GW of AI compute power by the end of 2027, and Firebird obtained a U.S. export license for 45,000 NVIDIA Grace GPUs to build a Kazakh data center aiming for about 500 MW capacity.
